card.name: Letters and numbers in list outlines
card.fires_on: A single list letter (d, e, h, j, m) or a comma or period inside a numbered or lettered item marker. It appears in quizzes, outlines, footnotes and section numbers like 7.2 – 7.4.

modes.label: Option letters in lists
modes.description: A lone letter marking the next item in an a/b/c question or answer list, just before its period.

modes.label: Punctuation inside numbering
modes.description: A comma or period within an article, section or footnote reference.
modes.example: as contemplated in Article 2<<,>> Geneva Prisoner of War Conventions,

card.writes: It favors name-like endings (Anderson, Aviv, Butt) and disfavors commas, 'and' and Chinese or Korean list separators, with no clear link to the list pattern.
card.plain: It fires on the small letter or mark that labels an item in a lettered list or a numbered reference.
